editorial.name: Smile.io
editorial.descriptionZh: Smile.io 是给 Shopify 品牌做会员忠诚度的平台，积分、付费会员、推荐和报表四块合一，也做 POS 与结账页的嵌入式模块。首页把 Built for Shopify 与 2026 Build Award Winner 两枚标放在主标题正上方。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看它把两颗平台认证标压在主标题正上方
editorial.noteZh: 首屏顶部一条浅蓝通栏写 2026 Build Award winner. Shopify's highest bar for apps，下面居中主标题 The leading loyalty platform for ambitious Shopify brands，副标题点名 Shopify Plus businesses 与 Optimized for Shopify at scale，按钮是 Let's talk 与 Unlock revenue。主标题上方居中挂着一枚双标胶囊：Built for Shopify 加 2026 Build Award Winner。往下 Everything you need to build customer loyalty 一块列了 Loyalty Hub（标 New）、Embedded Blocks、Checkout Extensions、Performance Benchmarks、Designed for Shopify POS、Promotions Engine 六张卡。再往下是 Boost repeat purchases. Maximize CLV. 的数据区、客户 logo 墙（NINE WEST、FIJI WATER、tp-link、NATURIUM、QUIKSILVER、Eddie Bauer）与 Enterprise loyalty, tailored your way。
editorial.pricing: 有 /pricing 页，首页只给 Let's talk 与 Book a demo

reasons.statement: 首页交付的是 Smile.io 自己的功能卡分区与客户 logo 墙，用户拿走的是首页结构；来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感池，故归产品与公司官网。
导航只有 Platform / Resources / Customers / Enterprise / Pricing 与 Sign in、Book a demo，是产品对外门面。
